yield.unit: one and a half inch cakes

steps: Add sugar gradually. Beat these ingredients until they are creamy.
Sift. before measuring. 1½ to 2 cup flour.
Resift with 1 tsp. any baking powder.
Beat batter well, Drop from teaspoon, well apart on greased tins. Permit batter to dry for 12 hrs.
Bake cakes in slow moderate oven 350°.
